2-ME is biotransformed by alcohol dehydrogenesis in testes of rats, mice and Wistar rats and in liver of all species examined.
2-ME is a poor substrate for alcohol dehyrogenase of testis from most mammalian species, including the rat, but is readily metabolized by this enzyme in hamster testis.
